reviews.review: Heard mixed things about Andromeda but I'm glad I gave it a shot because I really enjoyed it. The controls and combat felt really smooth. The writing was varied, there were parts that felt well written but some of the dialogue can seem a bit clunky. As for the characters, there were some who I felt strongly about (positive and negative) but many of the characters I felt pretty indifferent to. The game has the occasional bug but nothing too bad. Overall it's a fun game and well worth getting, especially if it's on sale.

I'm aware of the controversies generated by this game when originally released, but in its current state it's a good game worth playing. Is it my favourite Mass Effect game? No, it ranks fourth. But I find it more enjoyable than other games I've played in this genre. For example, I really liked getting the ability to jump-fly in combat, and while I loved the previous ME games, I always found it weird that I could never climb any obstacle taller than 12 inches in height or leap the difference (even on low gravity worlds: I'm looking at you, ME2). I do, however, have two lingering complaints about ME Andromeda that may never get fixed: first, whether on the PS4 console or even here in Steam on PC, something about how this game runs makes the cooling fans on consoles and PC just scream and constantly, and for reasons I don't understand; and, second, the powers that be dropped all plans for Andromeda DLC and sequels. I mean, come on. Sure, Andromeda had a rocky debut and no Shepard, but imagine if MLB clubs fired players in the season opener who didn't score a bases-loaded homer by the final inning. This is what happens when corporations favour shareholders over consumers. Thanks for ♥♥♥♥-all, EA. Free Bioware!
mid worth it if you really like the ME trilogy, but only discounted.

As a longtime original Mass Effect fan, I will say Andromeda is incredible! Quite different from the original trilogy but an amazing experience in itself!!! Highly recommended for those who love to explore alien worlds throughout space and defend against unknown threats.
